evals.prompt: I want to add a task for implementing dark mode to my app. It should update the UI theme based on the user's system preference.
evals.expected_output: Claude reads the active phase file, checks for WIP overload, asks for or derives a user-visible AC ('User sees the app switch to a dark colour scheme when their OS is set to dark mode'), and writes a correctly formatted cc:TODO row to the active phase file.

assertions.text: Acceptance criteria is user-visible (starts with 'User sees', 'App stores', etc.) and is not 'tests pass'
Task row uses correct format: | N.X | description | AC: ... | cc:TODO |
Status review prints a summary with cc:WIP/cc:TODO tasks and a suggested next action
New phase creation produces a phase-N.md file with a task table and correct status markers
Response checks or mentions WIP task count before adding new tasks
